from example.Person import Person


class Student(Person):
    def __init__(self, aName, aAge, aLocker):
        self._locker = aLocker
        super().__init__(aName, aAge)

    def setLocker(self, aLocker):
        self._locker = aLocker
        return True

    def getLocker(self):
        return self._locker

    def delete(self):
        super().delete()

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "locker:" + str(self.getLocker())
                + "]")
